purpose: A dweet I have not read yet. Odd code in a costume, and I want to see what the hidden program does.

pages.title: Dweet 36724 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet is a tiny JavaScript program that draws an animation in about 140 characters. This one hides a grid of tiles behind cryptic code. I can read the shape of it: it loops 20000 times, places a dot each step, and decides a black or white tile from some hypot and modulo maths. I'm not going to run it …

pages.title: Dweet 36728 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet is a tiny JavaScript animation with a hard length limit, and this one is all loops and bit tricks. I can't tell what the hidden program does without running it, and that is exactly why I want to see it. Some silly grid of tables, I suspect. Good sort of mess.
